# Framework (Aztec.nr, Aztec.js, etc) Release Notes: v4.1.3 → v4.2.0

**Date:** 2026-04-14
**Range:** `v4.1.3..v4.2.0` (2026-04-02 → 2026-04-14)
**Commits:** 135 framework-relevant commits

Full migration instructions for every breaking change below live in [`docs/docs-developers/docs/resources/migration_notes.md`](docs/docs-developers/docs/resources/migration_notes.md).

---

## Breaking Changes

### Aztec.nr

- **[Aztec.nr]** Capsule operations are now scoped by `AztecAddress`. `CapsuleArray::at` and all `capsules::{store,load,delete,copy}` functions require a new `scope` argument, and the PXE enforces scope access at runtime. ([#21533](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21533), [#22113](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22113), [#22136](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22136))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Domain-separated tags on every emitted log. Low-level `emit_private_log` / `emit_raw_note_log` / `emit_public_log` have been renamed `_unsafe` and now take `tag` as an explicit first parameter. Prefer the higher-level `emit` / `MessageDelivery` APIs. ([#21910](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21910), [#22027](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22027))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Public events no longer append the event type selector; a domain-separated tag is prepended at `fields[0]` instead. Direct consumers of `node.getPublicLogs` must update their parsing. ([#21910](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21910))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Private initialization nullifier now includes `init_hash` (Poseidon2 of `[address, init_hash]`). `assert_contract_was_initialized_by` / `_not_initialized_by` require an additional `init_hash` parameter. Contracts with external public functions can no longer be deployed with `skipClassPublication: true`. ([#21427](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21427))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Two separate init nullifiers (private + public) are now emitted. `only_self` functions skip init checks; external functions called during private init must be `#[only_self]`. ([#20775](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20775))
- **[Aztec.nr]** `attempt_note_discovery` (and related discovery helpers) now take separate `compute_note_hash` and `compute_note_nullifier` functions instead of a combined `compute_note_hash_and_nullifier`. The combined helper is deprecated. ([#21639](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21639))
- **[Aztec.nr]** `compute_note_hash_for_nullification` is now unconstrained; constrained nullification should use `compute_confirmed_note_hash_for_nullification`. Note-hash preimage order also changed (storage slot is now first for consistent domain separation). ([#21639](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21639))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Ephemeral arrays — internal framework refactor that changes how short-lived arrays are represented in generated circuits. ([#22162](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22162))
- **[Aztec.nr]** `app-silo getSharedSecret` oracle — shared-secret derivation is now app-siloed. Bumps `ORACLE_VERSION` to 21. ([#22020](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22020))
- **[Aztec.nr]** AES128 decrypt oracle now returns `Option` so callers can handle decryption failure without aborting. ([#21696](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21696))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Unused message discovery functions made private; only the supported discovery entry points remain public. ([#20831](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20831))
- **[Aztec.nr]** `process_message` auto-generated utility removed — use `offchain_receive` + `sync_state` instead. `CustomMessageHandler` gains a new `scope: AztecAddress` parameter. ([#20379](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20379), [#20893](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20893))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Offchain messages now emit the anchor block timestamp. ([#21414](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21414))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Event size is now validated at private emission rather than at declaration, enabling dynamic-sized events to compile. ([#22168](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22168))
- **[Aztec.nr]** `get_random_bytes` removed from `aztec::utils::random`; call the `random` oracle directly. ([#21639](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21639))
- **[Aztec.nr]** `storage_slot` moved from partial commitment into the note completion hash, enabling cleaner partial-note flows. ([#21351](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21351))

### aztec.js / PXE / Wallet SDK

- **[PXE]** `ALL_SCOPES` removed. `simulateTx`, `executeUtility`, `profileTx`, and `proveTx` now require an explicit `AztecAddress[]` for `scopes`. ([#22136](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22136))
- **[aztec.js]** `GasSettings.default()` → `GasSettings.fallback()`. `DEFAULT_GAS_LIMIT` and `DEFAULT_TEARDOWN_GAS_LIMIT` constants removed; limits now derive from protocol maxima. New `GasSettings.forEstimation()` for simulation with `skipTxValidation: true`.
- **[aztec.js]** `NO_FROM` sentinel replaces `AztecAddress.ZERO` for bypassing account-contract entrypoints. Multi-call flows must wrap payloads via `DefaultMultiCallEntrypoint` manually. ([#21716](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21716))
- **[aztec.js]** `ContractMetadata.isContractInitialized` → `initializationStatus` (tri-state enum: `INITIALIZED` / `UNINITIALIZED` / `UNKNOWN`). ([#21754](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21754))
- **[aztec.js]** `DeployMethod.send()` always returns `{ contract, receipt, instance }`; `DeployTxReceipt` and `DeployWaitOptions` removed along with the `returnReceipt` flag.
- **[aztec.js]** `ExecuteUtilityOptions.scope` renamed to `scopes: AztecAddress[]` to align with PXE / `sendTx`.
- **[aztec.js]** `getPublicEvents` now returns `{ events, maxLogsHit }`; use `afterLog` for pagination.
- **[aztec.js]** `computeL2ToL1MembershipWitness` signature changed — epoch is resolved internally from `txHash` and returned on the witness. New optional `messageIndexInTx` disambiguates duplicate messages.
- **[aztec.js]** `TxReceipt` now includes `epochNumber`.
- **[aztec.js]** `EmbeddedWalletOptions` consolidated `pxeConfig` + `pxeOptions` into a single `pxe` field (old fields deprecated). ([#22348](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22348))
- **[aztec.js / CLI]** Custom-token FPCs removed from the default public setup allowlist. `PublicFeePaymentMethod` / `PrivateFeePaymentMethod` and `fpc-public` / `fpc-private` CLI payment methods no longer work on public networks; switch to `FeeJuicePaymentMethodWithClaim`.
- **[PXE]** PXE rejects registering invalid addresses (e.g., infinity points) as senders, preventing a class of silent tag-computation failures. ([#22489](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22489), [#22026](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22026))
- **[PXE]** Log retrieval requests for contracts not in the current execution context are now rejected. ([#22047](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22047))
- **[Accounts]** Insecure `SchnorrSingleKeyAccount` contract removed. ([#21548](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21548))

---

## New Features

### Aztec.nr

- **[Aztec.nr]** **Custom message handlers** — contracts can register handlers for arbitrary offchain message types. ([#20379](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20379))
- **[Aztec.nr]** **Offchain reception + `offchain_receive`** — standard inbox for offchain messages, processed during `sync_state`. Utility functions can also emit messages. ([#20893](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20893), [#21422](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21422))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Initialization check added to utility functions. ([#21751](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21751))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Runtime-length arrays of sorts and selects. ([#22250](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22250))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Compile-time size check for events. ([#21024](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21024))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Note hash and nullifier helper functions. ([#21189](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21189))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Manual `Packable` implementations for structs with sub-`Field` members. ([#21576](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21576))
- **[Aztec.nr]** `BoundedVec` oracle returns are guarded against dirty trailing storage. ([#21589](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21589))
- **[Aztec.nr]** `env.deploy` accepts `salt` and `secret` parameters in tests. ([#21183](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21183))
- **[Aztec.nr]** All aztec-nr contract logs are prefixed with `[aztec-nr]` for easier debugging. ([#21080](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21080))

### aztec.js / PXE / Wallet SDK

- **[Wallet SDK]** **Iframe wallets SDK** — new SDK for embedding wallet flows in an iframe. ([#21978](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21978))
- **[CLI]** **`cli-wallet`** ships as a first-class package for scripting wallet operations from the terminal. ([#21757](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21757))
- **[aztec.js]** Gas estimation on `.send()` — callers no longer have to estimate separately. ([#21646](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21646))
- **[aztec.js]** **Entrypoint replay protection.** ([#21649](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21649))
- **[aztec.js]** Additional scopes supported on the wallet transaction API and `ContractFunctionPattern`. ([#20487](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20487), [#20660](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20660))
- **[aztec.js]** Auto-inject contract address into scopes for account deploys. ([#20665](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20665))
- **[PXE]** **Kernelless simulations by default** — dramatically faster simulation for dApp UIs. ([#21575](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21575))
- **[PXE]** Minor/major oracle version tracking — incompatible oracle versions now produce actionable error pages. ([#22254](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22254), [#21943](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21943))
- **[PXE]** Sync cache invalidation oracle. ([#21459](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21459))
- **[PXE]** `syncImmediate` verifies blockHash before applying state. ([#21556](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21556))
- **[PXE]** `warn_log_format` used for discarded messages for clearer debugging. ([#21053](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21053))

---

## Bug Fixes

### Aztec.nr / Reference Contracts

- **[Aztec.nr]** `check_notes_order` now performs a correct lexicographic multi-key sort. ([#21973](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21973))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Subfield note selectors resolve correctly. ([#22211](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22211))
- **[Aztec.nr]** `#[authorize_once]` generates the correct args length. ([#22209](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22209))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Out-of-bounds index fixed when using a nonzero offset. ([#21613](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21613))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Correct inverted constrained encryption check in message delivery. ([#21399](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21399))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Search all note nonces instead of only the note-index nonce. ([#21438](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21438))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Warn on unknown note type id. ([#21525](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21525))

### aztec.js / PXE

- **[PXE]** Prepopulated scopes in `simulateViaEntrypoint`. ([#22464](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22464))
- **[PXE]** `executeUtility` now respects `additionalScopes`. ([#22411](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22411))
- **[PXE]** Pass user call info from the wallet. ([#21937](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21937))
- **[PXE]** Tag computation no longer fails for invalid recipients. ([#22163](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22163))
- **[PXE]** Robust error handling in message processing; handle empty/malformed logs. ([#21093](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21093), [#21192](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21192))
- **[PXE]** `getSyncedBlockHeader` is a concurrency-1 job to prevent IndexedDB tx liveness issues. ([#21944](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21944))
- **[PXE]** Reject queries made ahead of the anchor block; use anchor block for `getL1ToL2MsgWitness`. ([#21874](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21874), [#21872](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21872))
- **[PXE]** Do not reuse tags of partially reverted txs. ([#20817](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20817))
- **[PXE]** Include validation reason in `simulate` error. ([#20768](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20768))
- **[PXE]** Warn and return first log instead of throwing on ambiguous log retrieval. ([#22044](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22044))
- **[aztec.js]** All account overrides and gas-limit flows work together. ([#22173](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22173))
- **[aztec.js]** `DeployAccountMethod` preserves type through `with()` chaining. ([#22322](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22322))
- **[aztec.js]** `AbiDecoder` decodes `EthAddress`, `FunctionSelector`, and wrapped Field structs. ([#21926](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21926))
- **[Wallet SDK]** Custom `PrivateKernelProver` supported; `EmbeddedWalletOptions` unified. ([#22348](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22348))
- **[CLI]** `cli-wallet` claim params parse decimal values via `Fr.fromString`. ([#22197](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22197))
- **[CLI]** Peek the claim stack for `estimate-gas-only` instead of popping it. ([#22196](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22196))

---

## Improvements

- **[Aztec.nr]** Use registered accounts as capsule test scopes. ([#22171](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22171))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Remove `aztec` dependency from `aztec_sublib`. ([#22033](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22033))
- **[PXE]** Oracle implementations renamed for consistency; legacy oracle mappings typed and audited. ([#22044](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22044), [#21569](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21569), [#22018](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22018))
- **[PXE]** Load all accounts before `LogService.#getSecretsForSenders` (A-779). ([#21923](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21923))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Dead globals, `to_be_bytes`, and old field comparison fns removed in favor of `lt`. ([#22244](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22244), [#22243](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22243), [#22249](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22249))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Consistent usage of contract-class-hash function. ([#22248](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22248))
- **[Aztec.nr]** Noir upgraded to nightly 2026-04-10 compatibility. ([#22393](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22393))

---

## Internal / Infrastructure

- Noir toolchain compatibility: removed comptime mutable methods, `mut` cleanups, nightly-02-27 and nightly-04-10 alignment. ([#21801](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21801), [#20798](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/20798), [#22393](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22393))
- `aztec compile` uses the bundled `bb` binary rather than relying on `$PATH`.
- Indefinite retry for prover-node / agent-broker communication. ([#22202](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22202))
- RPC endpoints for manipulating time in local networks. ([#22084](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22084))
- Date provider sync from Anvil stdout on every mined block. ([#21829](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21829))

NethermindEth/nethermind.body:
# Release notes

## Overview

> This release replaces 1.37.0

540 Changes across 2,651 Files. Major worldstate backend refactor, RocksDB snapshots, flat storage for snap sync, block-level access lists (EIP-7928), initial zkEVM groundwork, and a large round of JSON-RPC and EVM hot-path optimizations.

## Breaking changes

- **eth/66 and eth/67 dropped**; `eth/69` is now default and `eth/70` added and activated (#9938, #10246)
- **Engine API versioning reworked** (#10786)
- **Vault and NDM** code paths removed (#10478)

## Highlights

**Performance**

- Tx processing via encoded-tx trie root and fast block re-encode (#10435)
- `KeccakCache`, `SeqlockCache`, `FastHash` improvements (#10391, #10415, #10082)
- EVM hot paths: `EXP`/`MOD`/identity precompile (#10060, #10061, #10366)
- Pruning: +512MB default cache, skip GC, inline prunes (#10247, #10230, #10112)
- JSON-RPC parsing and processing optimized (#10207, #10389, #10453)

**State & storage**

- Worldstate backend refactor with pluggable backends (#9089)
- RocksDB and column DB snapshots (#10080, #10262)
- Flat storage for snap sync (#9854, #10426)
- Discv5 nodes moved to a separate DB (#10027)

**EVM extensibility**

- Policy-based gas tracking (#9846, #10068, #10692)
- External tracer registration (#10228)
- Witness generation (#9949) and zkEVM groundwork (#10561, #10773)

**Consensus & EIPs**

- Block-level access lists — EIP-7928 (#10357, #10325)

**RPC & correctness**

- `eth_estimateGas` fixes (#10559); `eth_getBlockByNumber` canonical enforcement (#10024)
- `eth_getLogs` faster (#9923); **log index** introduced (#8464)
- `engine_getBlobsV3` (#9942); `engine_getPayloadV4` for Optimism (#10328)
- `eth_subscribe transactionReceipts` (#10524)
- `debug_` block field overrides (#10405); `GasCap` enforced on debug/trace (#10457)
- Hardened RPC tx validations (#10395)

**Networking**

- Faster handshake parsing, Ethrex recognized (#9935)
- Discovery v5 optimized (#10081); better peer decentralization (#10090)

**Chain-specific**

- Taiko/Surge: Shasta changes, Hoodi activation, TDX attestation (#9998, #10406, #9954)
- XDC: P2P layer, EIP-1559, fast sync, penalty/reward handlers (#10615, #10277, #10549)
- OP Superchain: rolling updates

## Flat DB (opt-in)

Nethermind 1.37.0 ships a new **Flat DB** state backend that stores the latest state as flat account/storage records instead of walking the Merkle-Patricia trie. Faster random reads, streaming snap serving, and per-column cache budgets. **Disabled by default** — opt in with `--FlatDb.Enabled=true`.

### Activation

```
--FlatDb.Enabled=true
```

This swaps `FlatWorldStateModule` in for the pruning-trie wiring, disables `admin_prune` / `admin_verifyTrie`, and force-enables `Sync.SnapServingEnabled=true`.

### Migration from an existing pruning-trie DB

Set the import flag alongside `Enabled`:

```
--FlatDb.Enabled=true 
--FlatDb.ImportFromPruningTrieState=true
```

Run the node. On first boot the `ImportFlatDb` step streams the head state into the flat DB and then exits cleanly (exit code 0). **Just restart the node — the flag can stay on.** On subsequent boots the step detects the populated flat DB, logs `Flat db already exist`, and returns without exiting, so the node proceeds to normal operation. There is no automatic in-place migration without the flag: if you enable Flat DB on a node that already has pruning-trie data and don't set `ImportFromPruningTrieState`, the flat DB is simply empty and you'll sync from scratch.

`FlatLayout.PreimageFlat` cannot be the import target (the importer uses raw hash-keyed writes) — use `Flat` or `FlatInTrie` for the import run.

### Layouts — `-FlatDb.Layout`

| Value | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `Flat` (default) | Flat entries in a dedicated column DB with Hyper Clock caches (30% Account / 70% Storage of `BlockCacheSizeBudget`). |
| `FlatInTrie` | Entries embedded into trie leaves. `FlatRocksDbConfigAdjuster` adds `optimize_filters_for_hits=true`, partitioned filters, two-level index — lower memory, higher tail latency. |
| `PreimageFlat` | Preimage-DB-keyed layout. Requires a preimage DB populated via `--FlatDb.EnablePreimageRecording=true` on an earlier run. |

### All `FlatDb.*` flags (defaults from `FlatDbConfig.cs`)

| Flag | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enabled` | `false` | Master switch. |
| `Layout` | `Flat` | `Flat` / `FlatInTrie` / `PreimageFlat`. |
| `ImportFromPruningTrieState` | `false` | One-shot import from the pruning-trie DB; idempotent afterwards. |
| `EnablePreimageRecording` | `false` | Mirror account/slot hashes into a preimage DB. |
| `VerifyWithTrie` | `false` | Cross-check flat reads against a reconstructed trie. Diagnostic — slow. |
| `InlineCompaction` | `false` | Run compaction inline on writes instead of pooled. |
| `CompactSize` / `MinCompactSize` | `32` / `2` | Snapshot-group size bounds for hierarchical compaction. |
| `MaxInFlightCompactJob` | `32` | Compaction parallelism. |
| `MinReorgDepth` / `MaxReorgDepth` | `128` / `256` | Reorg retention window. |
| `TrieWarmerWorkerCount` | `-1` | `-1` = `CPU - 1`, `0` = disable warming. |
| `BlockCacheSizeBudget` | `1 GiB` | RocksDB block cache for the flat column family (split 30/70 Account/Storage). Stacks on top of `Db.*` budgets. |
| `TrieCacheMemoryBudget` | `512 MiB` | `TrieNodeCache` target; `0` disables it. |

## Config flag changes

Every user-facing config movement on `1.37.0` outside the `FlatDb.*` namespace. Flat DB flags are covered separately.

### Added

| Flag | PR | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Network.FilterPeersByRecentIp` | [[#10090](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10090)](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10090) | `true` | Reject peers whose IP key was seen recently (time-windowed). |
| `Network.FilterPeersBySameSubnet` | [[#10090](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10090)](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10090) | `true` | Bucket peer IPs by subnet (IPv4 `/24`, IPv6 `/64`). Set `false` for co-located multi-node setups. |
| `Network.FilterDiscoveryNodesByRecentIp` | [[#10090](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10090)](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10090) | `true` | Same filter for discovery. |
| `Network.FilterDiscoveryNodesBySameSubnet` | [[#10090](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10090)](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10090) | `true` | Subnet bucketing for discovery. |

### Removed

| Flag | PR | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Db.XdcSnapshotsDbRocksDbOptions` | [[#10329](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10329)](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10329) | Moved into `XdcRocksDbConfigFactory` in the XDC plugin. |
| `Db.XdcSnapshotsDbAdditionalRocksDbOptions` | [[#10329](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10329)](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/10329) | As above — delete from any XDC config overrides. |

### Default-value changes

- **Gnosis and Gnosis-archive** now ship with `Db.SkipCheckingSstFileSizesOnDbOpen=true` in [`[configs/gnosis.json](https://www.notion.so/nethermind/src/Nethermind/Nethermind.Runner/configs/gnosis.json)`](https://www.notion.so/nethermind/src/Nethermind/Nethermind.Runner/configs/gnosis.json) and [`[configs/gnosis_archive.json](https://www.notion.so/nethermind/src/Nethermind/Nethermind.Runner/configs/gnosis_archive.json)`](https://www.notion.so/nethermind/src/Nethermind/Nethermind.Runner/configs/gnosis_archive.json), cutting archive startup time. Override to `false` to restore the old behavior.
